# SAIL

> State–Action Information Leakage — a methodological audit, not a treatment recommendation
> system.

SAIL produced two real, separate artifacts from that audit: an open-source Python package,
`sail-leakage`, that checks a treatment dataset for five categories of state-action leakage, and
the research (proofs plus an empirical audit on 13,192 real ICU stays, with 11,354 under the
published Sepsis-3 table as a sensitivity cohort) that package generalizes from. Everything below
is real and currently shipped; nothing here is a roadmap item.

## Package

- [sail-leakage on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/sail-leakage/): `pip install sail-leakage`
- [Quickstart and the five detector categories](https://mohshahin.github.io/SAIL_State-Action-Information-Leakage/SAIL_PACKAGE_README.md): the verified-working `sail.check()` call, its real parameters, and the five real category names (`construction_leakage_1a`/`1b`, `reconstruction_leakage`, `temporal_overlap_leakage`, `timing_violation_leakage`, `persistence_dominance`)
- [Detectors, in depth](https://mohshahin.github.io/SAIL_State-Action-Information-Leakage/detectors/): what each category catches and the exact theorem or verification behind it

## VS Code extension

- [Extension README](https://github.com/MohShahin/SAIL_State-Action-Information-Leakage/blob/vscode-extension/extension/README.md): a setup wizard around the same package, plain-language results, everything local. Not yet on the Marketplace — build the `.vsix` from source (instructions in the README).

## Research

- [FORMAL_ANALYSIS.md](https://mohshahin.github.io/SAIL_State-Action-Information-Leakage/FORMAL_ANALYSIS.md): the full proofs each detector generalizes from
- [Proof](https://mohshahin.github.io/SAIL_State-Action-Information-Leakage/proof/): the same proofs, as an interactive page
- [Evidence](https://mohshahin.github.io/SAIL_State-Action-Information-Leakage/evidence/): the empirical audit's numbers, including two extraction bugs found and corrected in the open
